verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that third-party partner tools can plug into GitLab CI/CD pipelines: Pulumi's GitLab CI integration, DigiCert signing in pipelines, the Kilo CLI in pipelines, and Semgrep at CI time. That is a thin, indirect form of reusing externally built pipeline functionality. Nothing documents a reusable community component or catalog mechanism for CI/CD; the community catalog in the pack covers AI agents and flows, not pipeline steps. Missing for 10: documentation of a CI/CD component catalog or marketplace, a mechanism for including or versioning community-built pipeline components, and independent or hands-on corroboration of reusing community CI/CD building blocks.
